title: AirAsia Philippines to reduce workforce amid high fuel costs, currency pressures
summary: Low-cost carrier AirAsia Philippines announced on Thursday that it will reduce its workforce as elevated jet fuel prices and unfavorable exchange rates drive up operating costs.
